app.name: Assessment Platform
home.title: Pre/post assessment platform
home.subtitle: Run exams with QR codes and measure learning gain automatically. Works offline.
home.noExams: You haven't created any exams yet.
exam.title: Exam title
exam.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Fractions and percentages — unit assessment
exam.subject: Subject
exam.teacherEmailHint: The report will be sent to this address
exam.durationHint: Leave empty for no time limit
exam.shuffleHint: Different order per student, but identical for their pre and post test
delivery.online.hint: The classroom has internet. The QR points to a web address.
delivery.lan.hint: No internet, but the teacher has a laptop. Run `pnpm lan`.
delivery.offlineQr.hint: No internet and no computer. The whole exam fits inside the QR code.
question.title: Questions
question.acceptedAnswersHint: Separate with commas. Case and extra spaces are ignored.
import.title: Excel / CSV import
import.columns: Column order: type, text, optionA…optionF, correct, points, topic
import.correctHint: correct column: single/truefalse → A · multi → A;C · short → answer1,answer2
import.errorsFound: {count} rows had errors and were skipped
preview.title: Preview
preview.studentView: This is what students will see
qr.title: QR code
qr.tooManyQuestions: An exam with {count} questions needs {slides} QR codes in offline mode. Consider using LAN mode.
qr.localhostTitle: This QR cannot be scanned from a phone
qr.localhostBody: You opened this page via «localhost». The QR would contain «localhost» too, and a phone scanning it would look at ITS OWN localhost — so nothing opens.
qr.openInstead: Open this page at one of these addresses instead, then regenerate the QR:
qr.localhostManual: Reopen this page using your computer's network address (e.g. http://10.0.92.30:5173).
qr.sameWifi: Students must be on the same Wi-Fi network as the teacher.
teacher.linkSaved: The manage link has been saved on this device
teacher.linkWarning: Keep this link safe — it cannot be recovered if lost.
teacher.switchConfirmBody: {count} students have taken the pre-test. After switching, no more pre-test answers are accepted.
teacher.switchDone: Mode switched — now collecting post-test answers.
teacher.conflictsHint: Second submissions from the same student. Review and delete them.
collect.title: Collect answers
collect.cameraHttps: The camera requires the page to be served over https or localhost.
collect.manualCodeHint: Works only for exams with single-choice / true-false questions and at most 10 questions.
student.resumeFound: An unfinished attempt was found — continue?
student.timeUp: Time is up — your answers were submitted automatically
student.submitConfirmBody: {unanswered} questions are unanswered. You cannot change answers after submitting.
student.alreadySubmitted: You have already taken this exam.
result.title: Your result
result.answerQrHint: Your teacher will scan this to record your answers.
result.manualCodeHint: If the QR cannot be scanned, read this code to your teacher.
report.title: Report
report.queuedOffline: You are offline, so the email was queued. It will be sent automatically once you reconnect.
report.noData: Not enough data to produce a report.
report.lowSample: The sample is small, so the statistics are not reliable.
error.notFoundBody: The address may be wrong, or the exam may have been deleted.
error.network: Network error. Check your internet connection.
error.offlineAction: This action requires an internet connection.
error.qrTooLarge: The exam is too large to fit in a QR code. Use LAN mode instead.
pwa.offlineReady: The app is ready to work offline
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
auth.mustChangeBody: An administrator issued you a temporary password. Set your own password before continuing.
auth.forgotPassword: Forgot your password or don't have an account? Contact your school administrator.
auth.loginRequired: Please sign in to view this page.
auth.adminOnly: This page is for administrators only.
auth.setupTitle: The system is not set up yet
auth.setupBody: No administrator account exists. Run this command on the server to create the first one:
auth.setupHint: The command prints a temporary password once — copy it.
admin.title: User management
admin.subtitle: Create teacher accounts, disable them, reset passwords
admin.noTeachers: No teacher accounts have been created yet.
admin.newAccountHint: The system generates a temporary password and shows it once. Pass it on to the teacher.
admin.usernameHint: Latin letters, digits, dots and dashes only. Example: teacher.ganbat
admin.tempPasswordNote: A temporary password is generated automatically. The teacher must change it on first sign-in.
admin.credentialWarning: This password CANNOT be shown again. Copy it now and give it to the teacher.
admin.credentialHint: The teacher sets their own password on first sign-in. If forgotten, reset it here.
admin.deleteBody: You are about to permanently delete the account of {name}.
admin.deleteHint: Teachers who own exams cannot be deleted. Disabling instead keeps their exams and reports.
admin.smtpSetupHint: To configure, fill in SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASS in the server's `.env` file and restart the service. For Gmail you need an «App Password», not your normal password.
